subject.size_in_frame: small and going away, about 0.14 of frame height, dropping to 0.10 as he reaches the corner

headroom: about 0.24 of frame height of brick vault and glowing corner wall above him; the vault stays over him through the drop from haunches to four legs, so the change of posture happens under a ceiling, at animal height.
horizon_eyeline: Floor line running to the corner at [0.56, 0.54]. His eyeline is low and forward, aimed round the corner; it never turns back along the passage.

layers.fg: the pastel-and-gold mosaic dado passing close along the left edge of frame, its vine ornament large and soft
layers.mg: the Rabbit dropping onto four legs and running
layers.bg: the right-angle corner glowing with warm lamplight from the hall beyond

gaze.note: he goes away and round to frame right, into the glow; about 0.20 of frame width of lit corner is left ahead of him, and he uses all of it and leaves.

balance: Left-loaded by the near mosaic, with the small moving subject drifting right into the light — the frame hands him off rather than holding him.
leading_lines: The mosaic dado band runs from the near left edge into depth and turns at the corner; the floor edge does the same. Both deliver him round the turn, and the audience with him.
eye_first: The lit corner, then the small white shape crossing into it.
constraint_binding: QUADRUPED RABBIT — the drop from haunches back onto four legs happens in shot: the whole body is in frame, uncropped, for the whole transition, so the grammar is established once and can never be contradicted. Clean single for the line: Alice is not in this frame.
